fld.fiscalStartDayHint: Optional, 1 to 28: the day of the start month the financial year begins on. Empty means the 1st.

registry.publishTypeHintFiscal: Publishes the type definition. Enter it as JSON. A validity block that aligns to the financial year end takes fiscalStartMonth (1 to 12) and, optionally, fiscalStartDay (1 to 28; empty means the 1st), for example "validity": {"period": "P1Y", "alignTo": "FISCAL_YEAR_END", "fiscalStartMonth": 4, "fiscalStartDay": 1}.
